query:
with capacity as materialized (
            select kind.id, least($2, kind.sales_stock) as granted
            from products kind
            where kind.id = $1 and kind.sales_stock is not null
            for update of kind
        ), updated as (
            update products
            set sales_stock = sales_stock - capacity.granted
            from capacity
            where products.id = capacity.id
            returning products.id
        )
        select capacity.granted::int as "granted!"
        from capacity
